question.text: A particle is projected from the ground with a kinetic energy $E$ at an angle of $60^{\circ}$ with the horizontal. Its kinetic energy at the highest point of its motion will be

solution.text:
At ground, $E=\frac{1}{2} m u^{2}$ 
At highest point, $E^{\prime}=\frac{1}{2} m\left(u \cos 60^{\circ}\right)^{2}$
$$
E^{\prime}=\frac{E}{4}
$$
